title: QoS panel internal draw geometry left unscaled while the panel rect/rows scale with the UI knob
detail: At ×1.25/×1.50 the lane proportion bar, queue-depth row, and rejection toast draw at raw unscaled positions inside the scaled panel — misaligned with the scaled rows/panel edge, breaking the E9.3 scaling AC on this surface.
recommended_fix: Route these draw sites through rnd.hud()/hud_f() like the rest of the panel (bar origin/width, depth label x/size, reject toast x/size/inset).

title: Crisis-outline swell duplicates the reduced-motion pin instead of routing through pulse_read, despite its comment claiming it does
detail: Two hand-kept copies of the reduced-motion static pin; the PR claims pulse_read is 'the single seam every animated pulse consumer routes through'. If the pin value changes, crisis drifts.
recommended_fix: Add a bundle-phase variant of pulse_read (or inline the flag through it) and have draw_crisis_outlines consume it; delete the local PULSE16 lookup.

title: mouse_map's key scratch array holds 10 but 11 keys are collectable
evidence: keys: [10]Key — collected cases: .P/.Space, .D, .T, .M, .S (sel_pipe<0 only), .Up,.Down,.Left,.Right,.Enter, .Esc = 11 distinct entries, each guarded "if keys_n < len(keys)".
detail: A frame pressing all collectable keys at once silently drops the last one (guard prevents overflow, so no crash). Pathological, but the array is one slot short of the collectable set.
recommended_fix: Bump the scratch array to [11]Key (or 12 for headroom) so no collectable key is ever dropped.
